summary:
Payment and banking innovation and end-to-end business model success responsibility: Identifying early-stage trends & opportunities. Developing new ideas, and the right customers and strategic partners for successful market adoption of new payment and value-added services. Relentless focus on business value and proven business models.

Also launched the acceptance of value-added payment methods (Alipay and WeChat Pay) for Wirecard from a product as well as business development perspective, and ConnectedPOS, Wirecard’s merchant ecosystem integration platform.

Proven leadership track record with 7 years line management experience, clear written and personal communication skills and professional public representation.

8 years experience in the value-added services and payment / fintech industry for retail and hospitality. Proven focus on omni-channel solutions.

Entrepreneur at heart: Founded and operated BANKSapi with more than 3,000 connected banks, credit card issuers and investment depots. Founded and operated 10stamps with 270,000 users, 3,500 retail locations in D, A, CH.

company.name: BANKSapi
company.tagline: We enable access to millions of bank accounts to streamline processes and provide turnkey insights & value - with 1 API.
company.description:
BANKSapi operates a smart and highly scalable Open Banking and Open Finance platform for Account Information Services (AIS), Payment Information Services (PIS), analytics, front ends and applications. 

We develop and operate REST-APIs and GUIs all around the topic of finance. As a specialised connectivity and payment provider, we are fully dedicated to the growth areas of Open Banking and Open Finance.

To make this possible, we provide account information services and offer payment initiation services on our regulated and secure platform as a payment institution approved by the German authorities (BaFin). 

Due to our advanced, AI-based data analytics, we offer high-performance value-added services for a wide range of use cases (e.g. contract recognition, age verification, KYC light based on account data or affordability checks). 

In addition, we realise and operate your personal finance or business finance application as a web portal or mobile app cost-effectively with our front-end technology platform. 

With our SaaS and ASP solutions, we maximally reduce complexity for our clients from a multitude of industries (e.g. insurance companies, ERP & accounting, financial advisory) and enable new use cases and business models for them.

BANKSapi Technology GmbH is a venture of Finconomy AG.
